text:
Type: moulded white photo frame with mat
Use: framing art prints or family photos for a gallery wall or a shelf; living room, hallway, bedroom, study
Style: classic, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: white painted frame with a stepped moulding, cream mat board, clear front panel
Colors: bright white, cream white mat
Shape: upright rectangle with a raised bevelled border, a generous mat that centers the image, slim depth, flat and light on the wall
Feel: tidy, fresh, gentle, classic
Goes with: family photos, sketches, pale wood, soft neutral walls; classic, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: VIRSERUM
product.description: Fits A4 size pictures if used with the mount.
